parts.style: calm, reverent, reading scripture aloud slowly
parts.text: Be careful for nothing; <short pause> but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God. <short pause> And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus. <short pause> Philippians, chapter four, verses six and seven.

Heavenly Father, I bring You everything that weighs on my mind tonight. <short pause> With thanksgiving, I lay my requests before You. <short pause> Guard my heart and mind with Your peace that goes beyond understanding. <short pause> I release my worries into Your keeping and rest in Christ Jesus. <short pause> Amen.
